rows.l1_text: For my younger brother's birthday, I chose a kit for making a robot.
It was because I thought that assembling it himself would be more fun than buying a finished toy.
Inside the box, there were small parts and instructions.
My younger brother attached the parts one by one while looking at the steps, and took two days to complete the robot.
Seeing the robot start moving, my younger brother said with shining eyes, "Next I want to make a robot that I design myself."
At my grandmother's house, she raises ten chickens.
Every morning, I help feed the chickens.
On cold days, my grandmother pays attention to the temperature of the coop.
Also, once a week, she weighs the chickens and checks whether they are healthy.
All of my grandmother's chickens are healthy and lay eggs every day.
A small robot came to my grandmother's house.
This robot does things like telling my grandmother when to take her medicine and saying the day's weather.
At first my grandmother said, "I don't understand machines well," but now she talks with the robot every day.
Thanks to the robot, my grandmother's life has become a little more enjoyable.
My older sister likes drawing pictures and makes T-shirts herself.
First she draws a design on paper, and then prints it on a white T-shirt.
The number of colours used is small, but it becomes an original piece of clothing that is the only one in the world.
When she made some for her friends too, they were very pleased.
The plan to build a new library in the town was decided.
The architect who was in charge of the design valued incorporating the voices of the local people.
When he listened to them, many people wanted not only a place where they could read books quietly, but also a place where their families could gather casually.
So he created an open space where light comes in through large windows, and also provided a room where children can play.
The completed library has a bright atmosphere, and now it has become a new place of relaxation for the town.
When I was tidying up my grandmother's room, a bundle of old letters was found.
They were letters that my grandfather had sent to my grandmother when he was young and working in a distant town.
In an era when there were not many telephones, they say the two conveyed their feelings to each other by letter once a week.
From the words written in neat handwriting, feelings of cherishing the other person came across.
My grandmother told me nostalgically, "With letters, the time spent waiting until they arrived was fun too."
The people of ancient Rome built long aqueducts out of stone in order to carry water from distant mountains to towns.
The aqueducts were made with a very slight slope, and the water flowed naturally without using machines.
Thanks to this technique, the people of the town were able to use clean water every day.
Water supply was the foundation of people's lives, and it is said to be one of the reasons Rome was able to grow into a large city.
Even now, parts of them remain in various places in Europe.
Ms. Tanaka, who is in charge of raising bears at the zoo, changes the amount of food depending on the season.
When autumn comes, wild bears eat a lot in preparation for winter and gain weight.
Apparently, the zoo's bears likewise get more food in autumn.
However, since many bears at the zoo do not hibernate, she adjusts it finely so that they do not gain too much weight.
Ms. Tanaka says, "The most important thing is that the bears can live a life close to nature."
Misaki, a university student, sells handmade accessories on the internet.
At first they hardly sold, but she tried various ideas, such as taking nice photos of the products and sharing the steps of making them in videos.
Then, little by little, the number of people watching increased, and now she can earn income, though only a small amount, every month.
Misaki says, "It is very fun that what I like is turning into work."
At emergency scenes, every minute and every second concerns a patient's life.
When a person who has suffered a major injury in an accident or the like is brought in, doctors and nurses immediately examine the condition of the body and start the necessary treatment.
At this time, it is important that each and every person reliably fulfills their own role.
By deciding in advance who will do what, they can move quickly without panicking.
Emergency medicine is supported by the power of such teams.
In order to produce rice that grows well even in cold regions, a certain researcher has continued improving varieties for more than ten years.
The work of crossbreeding many varieties and selecting ones that are strong against cold and also taste good takes a lot of time.
He failed many times, but the researcher did not give up, analyzed the records, and changed the growing environment little by little.
And finally, he succeeded in developing a new variety.
Now, that rice supports the important income of farmers in cold regions.
There is a big bell at the old temple in the town.
Since long ago, the people of the temple have rung this bell every evening.
When they hear that sound, the children stop playing and go home.
My grandfather says, "The sound of this bell is an important promise of the town."
Even now, everyone in the town protects this bell together.
My older brother formed a band in high school.
There are four members, and my older brother is in charge of the vocals.
On the day he first stood on the stage, my older brother was very nervous, and the hand holding the microphone was trembling.
But as he practiced many times, he gradually got used to the stage.
Now he says that singing is the most fun.
My younger brother was playing soccer and hurt his leg.
My mother took my younger brother to the hospital right away.
The doctor looked at his leg and said, "It is not a major injury, so you don't need to worry."
Then he washed the wound clean and treated it by applying medicine.
My younger brother ended up resting from soccer for a week.
On Sunday, we went to a nearby park as a family.
Sunlight filtering through the leaves came in under the big trees, and it felt very pleasant.
My father took a photo of that scenery, and my mother and younger sister ate their packed lunches.
The park is a place of relaxation for the people of the town, and many families were playing happily.
Rock is music that was born in America in the 1950s.
If you trace its roots, you arrive at various kinds of music that existed before then, such as blues and country.
Rock afterward spread around the world and evolved into various forms depending on the country and era.
In Japan too, many bands took on the challenge of singing in Japanese instead of English, and built their own unique rock.
It is interesting that a single kind of music is reborn anew by encountering other cultures.
A T-shirt that my grandfather wore when he was young turned up from the back of the storeroom.
Its colour had completely faded, but the name of the town where my grandfather was born was printed on the chest.
I decided to use that design as a reference and make a new T-shirt.
I thought that I wanted to give form to respect for my family's roots, rather than just fondly remembering old memories.
When I showed him the finished T-shirt, my grandfather was a little surprised and smiled happily.
My friend moved to China with her family last year.
Last week, a letter arrived from her.
In the letter, there was a photo of her new school.
It said, "Chinese is still difficult, but every day is fun."
I wrote a reply right away and sent it together with a photo of the town.
I hear it will arrive in about two weeks.
The shopping street in front of the station had been losing customers since the big supermarket opened.
So, local high school students started an activity to promote the charm of the shopping street.
They listened to the people at each shop and introduced the shops' histories and recommended products on the internet together with photos.
Then, young people and customers coming from outside the town gradually increased.
The shop owners are delighted, saying, "They showed us a good point that we had not noticed ourselves."
Broilers are a breed of chicken raised to be made into meat.
In only about fifty days after birth, their weight grows to nearly three kilograms.
Farmers finely adjust the temperature of the chicken coops and the amount of feed, and raise them efficiently.
Chickens raised in this way are shipped on a decided day and line the shelves of stores such as supermarkets.
The reason we can eat chicken cheaply every day is that this production system supports the foundation of our food.
I go to high school by bicycle every day.
It is about twenty minutes from home to school, but in the morning I find myself hurrying and going too fast.
One day, I almost collided with a child who came out from a corner, and I was very surprised.
Since then, I leave home a little early and make sure to follow the traffic rules reliably.
When I have time to spare, my mind also calms down, and I have become able to enjoy the scenery of the town too.
My younger brother was bad at memorizing English words.
However, since he started playing a word game on his smartphone recently, he has become able to memorize them little by little.
In the game, he gets a badge when he answers correctly, so apparently he can keep going happily.
It is only about ten minutes every day, but they say that as he repeated it, he got used to the words and they also became easier to remember.
It is not just playing; with appropriate stimulation, the efficiency of studying changes greatly.
The town of Rome in the old days was surrounded by high walls.
People carried large stones one by one and piled them up high.
The walls were meant to protect the lives of the townspeople from enemies coming from outside.
Even now, part of the walls remains in Rome, and many people come to see it.
At the high school cultural festival, our band decided to present an original song.
Playing a famous song would easily get the crowd excited, but we dared to want to sing in our own words.
All the members thought up the lyrics together, and we packed them with each person's memories of high school life.
On the day, my hands shook when I stood on the stage, but I performed with all my heart until the end.
After the performance, we received a lot of applause, and it became an unforgettable experience for us.
